definitions.gloss: to cure; to heal; to remedy
definitions.explanation: To restore someone to health by treating a disease or injury. The subject is the person or thing doing the healing (a doctor, medicine, etc.).

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}が{病気|びょうき}を{治|なお}した。
この{薬|くすり}で{風邪|かぜ}を{治|なお}すことができる。
examples.english: You can cure a cold with this medicine.

examples.japanese: {虫歯|むしば}は{早|はや}めに{歯医者|はいしゃ}で{治|なお}したほうがいい。
examples.english: It's better to have cavities treated at the dentist early on.

notes:
This is the medical/healing なおす, written with {治|なお}す. It means to cure illness or heal injury, as opposed to {直|なお}す which means to fix or repair broken objects or mistakes. Both are read なおす but use different kanji.

CONTRAST WITH {直|なお}す:
- {治|なお}す — to cure/heal (illness, injury)
- {直|なお}す — to fix/repair (broken objects, mistakes)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {治|なお}す (transitive) — someone cures something
- {治|なお}る (intransitive) — something heals/gets better on its own

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {病気|びょうき}を{治|なお}す — to cure an illness
- {怪我|けが}を{治|なお}す — to heal an injury
- {虫歯|むしば}を{治|なお}す — to treat a cavity
- {風邪|かぜ}を{治|なお}す — to cure a cold
